Class BodyPieces

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.http.client.BodyPieces
All Implemented Interfaces:
PieceReader<ByteBuffer<?>>, Closeable, AutoCloseable
@Internal public final class BodyPieces extends Object implements PieceReader<ByteBuffer<?>>
The pieces of a response body as they were received, as heap buffers that are not reference counted. Empty pieces are skipped.
Since:
5.3.0
Author:
Denis Stepanov
